method.alignment: PCM from strikeFrame; fields/rawPickup from ceil(strikeFrame/8) physics frame
method.spectrum: whole post-strike rectangular FFT; one-sided power scaled by Parseval, stereo summed; field spectrum sums per-node power then divides by node count
method.fixedBinAnalysis: 50 Hz half-open frequency intervals from 0 to 3000 Hz; descriptive resolution only, not auditory bands or thresholds; per-case bin rows include absolute power and normalized shares
method.pairedEnvelope: cosine of disjoint 25 ms RMS windows using only the common complete windows
method.timing: cumulative energy shares and post-peak remaining-energy thresholds; no T60 fit
method.interpretation: descriptive output/material comparisons only; spectral shape does not establish listener distinguishability
